chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from 'Uthman from Sama'ah from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

“There is no prayer for the two Eids except with the Imam, and if you pray alone, there is no harm.” And I asked him about eating before going out on the day of Eid, so he said, “Yes, and if you do not eat, there is no harm.”

key_terms.اَلْعِيدَيْنِ: The two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Eid prayers individually and is it recommended to eat before going to the Eid prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Sahih al-Tusi clarifies that Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha prayers are not strictly congregational obligations (fard al-ayn) but rather emphasized communal acts (sunnah mu'akkadah) where the Imam's presence is preferred for unity. It further highlights the prophetic etiquette of consuming dates or light food before departure, a practice rooted in the Sunnah to distinguish Eid al-Fitr from the fasting month, while affirming flexibility for individual performance.
